title: Presolana mountain long run
terrain: mountain trail, ~600m D+, power-hike steep climbs, controlled descents

steps.target: Z2, 145-155bpm, power-hike steep climbs, cadence 174+ on flats

coachNotes:
EXECUTION: ~2h, about 600m D+ (550-650). Hike anything steep to stay under 155bpm. Last sustained climb (~18min) at 160-166bpm, then descend easy. Descents controlled, cadence 170+.
GYM: none.
FUEL: 2 flasks Tailwind (500ml, 2 scoops each), one per hour from min 20, plus 1 Carbo Gel at ~1h30. First run on the new mix, treat it as the gut rehearsal.
STOP RULE: skip the Z3 climb if Friday or Saturday HRV is amber. Above 2,000m HR reads unreliably, go by RPE 4 on climbs. Walk down if cadence falls under 165 or the quads are shot.
WHY: first real vertical since Pirin, and climbing at tempo on tired legs is what VWT's 914m D+ demands. Replaces the flat fast-finish run.
